messages:
emily: hi all — i'm on an Apple Silicon Air and trying to follow the quickstart. brew is under /opt/homebrew and asdf isn't picking up the node/ruby installs. i'm also on fish. any tips?

bootstrap-bot: Welcome emily! :tada: Quick checks: run `which brew` and `asdf current` and paste the output here.

emily: `which brew` -> /opt/homebrew/bin/brew
asdf current -> no plugin installed for nodejs
I installed asdf via brew and added to my fish config like this:

set -x PATH /opt/homebrew/opt/asdf/bin $PATH
source /opt/homebrew/opt/asdf/libexec/asdf.fish

but `asdf list` is empty and `asdf plugin-list` returns nothing.

kevin: Two quick pointers: 1) On Apple Silicon brew lives in /opt/homebrew so make sure that path is exported before any other brew installs. 2) asdf plugins are separate from the asdf binary — installing the brew package doesn't auto-add node/ruby plugins.
Also run `echo $PATH` in fish and confirm /opt/homebrew/bin appears. If a plugin needs gpg keys (nodejs) you may need to run the import in bash.

sam: If you used the homebrew asdf package, ensure asdf init is in your shell startup. For fish add to `~/.config/fish/config.fish`:

# asdf
set -gx ASDF_DIR ~/.asdf
source /opt/homebrew/opt/asdf/libexec/asdf.fish

Then restart the shell. steps i usually run:

1) asdf plugin-add nodejs https://github.com/asdf-vm/asdf-nodejs.git
2) bash ~/.asdf/plugins/nodejs/bin/import-release-team-keyring  # run in bash
3) asdf install nodejs 18.16.0
4) asdf global nodejs 18.16.0

If the gpg import fails in fish, switch to bash just for that command.

emily: ahhh that was it — i tried the import in fish and it errored. switched to bash and the import worked. node installed fine after that. thanks!

emily: quick followup — where do we put project env vars? direnv (.envrc) or commit .env? i'm used to .env files but want to follow company norms.

kevin: we prefer direnv + .envrc for per-project env. add `source_env .env` in .envrc if you like keeping a .env. keep secrets out of repo and use vault/secret manager for creds that need to be shared. also add `.env` to .gitignore.

emily: last minor snag — my ssh key wasn't being picked up by the agent on my first push. running `ssh-add --apple-use-keychain ~/.ssh/id_ed25519` fixed it. posting here in case others hit it.

devops-mentor: Nice find. One more tip: run `brew doctor` and check `asdf` health. If you need x86 bottles for any older tools you can install Rosetta with `softwareupdate --install-rosetta --agree-to-license`. Also if you run into permissions issues ensure /opt/homebrew permissions are correct (brew will suggest fixes).

emily: everything's green now — node, ruby, ssh, direnv. big thanks you all :heart:

sam: :tada: welcome aboard!
